result.notes: Gladly is an enterprise CX/helpdesk platform sold via sales-led, 12-month contracts with custom pricing; no self-serve free tier or public trial for the core product (a separate Shopify-app 30-day trial exists but likely doesn't expose the full REST API). Once an org is a customer, an admin must grant a user the 'API User' role in Settings to generate a Basic Auth token — so credentials are gated behind both being a paying customer and admin action. REST API documented at developer.gladly.com/rest/ covers ~13 resource categories (Agents, Conversations, Customers, Webhooks, Reports, etc.) with dozens of endpoints — sized as medium breadth. No official vendor MCP server found; StackOne offers a third-party/community MCP connector with 65 actions.
result.one_liner: Gladly is an enterprise customer-service/helpdesk platform unifying channels (voice, chat, email, SMS) into a single customer timeline, with an AI agent add-on.
